Container.Name: DayFront
Container.Overview: DayFront is the open-source CalDAV frontend for calendars and tasks. Connect it to an existing standards-compliant CalDAV server and keep ownership of your data. DayFront has no built-in user login; expose it only through a trusted network or authenticating reverse proxy.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: calendar caldav tasks todo ics self-hosted
Container.Requires: An accessible CalDAV server. Create /mnt/user/appdata/dayfront/config.yaml from the documented example and enter your server URL and credentials before starting the container.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: DayFront HTTP port. Put this behind HTTPS and authentication when exposed outside a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Configuration Directory
Config.Description: Directory containing config.yaml with the CalDAV connection settings. Mounted read-only because DayFront never modifies it.

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: System timezone used for container logs and runtime behavior, for example UTC or America/Toronto.

Config.Name: Calendar Display Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used to display and interpret calendar values. Use local for each browser's timezone, UTC, or an IANA name such as America/Toronto.

Config.Name: Trust Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when DayFront is directly behind a trusted proxy that overwrites forwarded headers.
